topic: Unlocking Planar Graphs: Euler's Characteristic and Duality
target_audience: University students (Computer Science or Mathematics major)

sections.title: Prerequisite: Defining the Planar Graph
lecture_lines: Vertices, edges, and faces define structure.
Faces include the outer infinite region.
animations: Show a simple planar graph with 4 vertices [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/vertex.svg] and 4 edges [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/edge.svg] in #FFFFFF.
Highlight all vertices [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/vertex.svg] using a pulsing #FF5733 effect.
Highlight all edges [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/edge.svg] using a pulsing #33FF57 effect.

sections.title: Euler’s Characteristic Formula (V - E + F = 2)
lecture_lines: V minus E plus F equals 2.
Moving vertices preserves this constant value.
animations: Display the formula V - E + F = 2 in #FFFFFF alongside a visual representation [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/polyhedron.svg].
Highlight the variable V in #FF5733 and label with 'Vertices'.
Highlight the variable E in #33FF57 and label with 'Edges'.
Highlight the variable F in #3357FF and label with 'Faces'.
Emphasize the final result '= 2' with a flashing #FFFFFF effect, showing a simple [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/polygon.svg] to demonstrate the concept.

sections.title: The Concept of Graph Duality
lecture_lines: Place nodes inside each original face.
animations: Draw a planar graph in #FFFFFF and its dual graph in #FFC300.
Animate lines connecting the dual vertices through the faces of the original graph.
Show the dual transformation with a smooth fade-in for the new edges.

sections.title: Properties and Mapping
lecture_lines: Faces become vertices, vertices become faces.
animations: Show the mapping of faces to vertices of the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/polyhedron.svg] with color-coded arrows in #FFFFFF.
Highlight one face in #FF5733 and its dual vertex in the same color on the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/polyhedron.svg].
Demonstrate the one-to-one correspondence between dual edges and original edges using the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/polyhedron.svg].

sections.title: Synthesis and Summary
animations: Display the Euler formula V - E + F = 2 in #FFFFFF.
Summarize the duality relationship using a central diagram showing the original and dual graphs by incorporating [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/graph.svg].
Fade all elements to grey #808080 except the final formula and the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/network.svg] to emphasize the key takeaway.
